# Artix user-service audit fixtures

Unmodified configuration/service files extracted from the official Artix mirror.
`packages.json` records exact package versions, archive URLs, repository SHA-256
values, dependencies and extracted paths. These are test inputs only, never
installer overlays or replacement upstream configurations. Service script
copyright/license comments are retained. Runtime behavior still needs a VM.

Reviewed: OpenRC 0.64.1-2; pambase 20260616-1; dbus-openrc 20260805-1;
LightDM 1:1.33.1-1; pipewire-openrc and pipewire-pulse-openrc 20260426-2;
wireplumber-openrc 20250516-1. Upstream source locations include
https://gitea.artixlinux.org/packages/ and
https://github.com/OpenRC/openrc/tree/0.64.1 .
